articles.title: Jupiter: The Giant Planet That's a Failed Star
articles.summary: Jupiter is so huge that 1,300 Earths could fit inside it! It has a storm bigger than our whole planet and a moon that might hide alien life. Would you visit?

articles.title: A New Musical Movie About Neighbors Who Learn to Be Friends
articles.summary: A Broadway star and a singer from GENTRI star in 'Brotherhood,' a musical about two neighbors—one from Mexico, one American—who become friends. It opens in theaters October 9!

articles.title: Usher and Chris Brown's Epic Tour: Surprise Guests and a Stage Kick!
articles.summary: Usher and Chris Brown are on a huge R&B tour, and they've brought out stars like 50 Cent and Mary J. Blige. Usher even kicked a bored fan off stage!
